svg.title: A Lagrangian expander neck
svg.desc: Numerical quadrature of an exact integral parametrization · projection from C²

g.text: Numerical quadrature of an exact integral parametrization · projection from C²
a₁ = a₂ = 1, α = 1/2; |y| ≤ 2.8. The surface has two planar ends.
Use 4D rotation in the reader. Projected crossings do not mean self-intersection.
